body.name: Null-preserving observed-data mixture handle
body.construction: Apply \(\mathrm{MixtureHandle}\) to the full four-cell Bernoulli likelihood, retaining the transition regions observed under \(X\sim\lambda\); determine the partition scale, moment-matching order, and perturbation amplitudes from the separate Hölder constraints and the requirement that every null draw have constant \(\tau\).
